title: Augmented Equivariant Mesh Networks for Anatomical Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2605.08172v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Anatomical mesh segmentation requires models that operate directly on irregular surface geometry while remaining robust to changes in coordinate pose across meshes of varying resolution. Existing task-specific mesh and point-cloud methods are not equivariant, and can degrade sharply under test-time perturbation, for example dropping by 28-30 IoU points on 3D-IOSSeg at $40^\circ$ rotation even with matched training augmentation. We present EAMS, an Equivariant Anatomical Mesh Segmentor built on Equivariant Mesh Neural Networks (EMNN), and evaluate it in four dataset settings across three clinical application areas, spanning edge-, vertex-, and face-level supervision. We combine intrinsic mesh descriptors with anatomy-aware priors, including PCA-derived frames for dental arches and liver surfaces, and augment message passing to provide lightweight global context. translated_title: 用于解剖结构分割的增强等变网格网络
translated_abstract: 解剖网格分割需要能够直接处理不规则表面几何的模型，同时在不同分辨率网格之间对坐标姿态的变化保持鲁棒性。现有的任务专用网格和点云方法不具备等变性，在测试时的扰动下性能会急剧下降，例如在3D-IOSSeg数据集上，即使使用了匹配的训练数据增强，在40°旋转下IoU仍会下降28-30个点。我们提出了EAMS（等变解剖网格分割器），它建立在等变网格神经网络（EMNN）之上，并在三个临床应用领域的四种数据集设置中进行了评估，涵盖边级、顶点级和面级监督。我们将内在网格描述符与解剖感知先验相结合，包括用于牙弓和肝脏表面的PCA导出坐标系，并增强消息传递机制以提供轻量级的全局上下文。在颅内动脉瘤和口内分割任务中，EAMS……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于等变网格神经网络的EAMS模型，通过结合内在网格描述符与解剖感知先验，实现了对旋转等测试时扰动具有鲁棒性的解剖网格分割。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes EAMS, an Equivariant Anatomical Mesh Segmentor built on Equivariant Mesh Neural Networks, which combines intrinsic mesh descriptors with anatomy-aware priors to achieve robust anatomical mesh segmentation under test-time perturbations such as rotation.
